name: spec-drift
description: Diffs a living spec against a codebase and reports where they have drifted apart.

scripts.example: tsx src/cli/index.ts check --spec fixtures/orders-api/spec.md --schema fixtures/orders-api/schema.graphql --llm mock --recordings fixtures/orders-api/recordings --no-cache
scripts.example:clean: tsx src/cli/index.ts check --spec fixtures/orders-api-clean/spec.md --schema fixtures/orders-api/schema.graphql --llm mock --recordings fixtures/orders-api-clean/recordings --no-cache
